lines.en: Drifting in; no one can stop me.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得飞快，影子却很小。
lines.en: Wings beat fast; my shadow stays small.

lines.zh: 我穿过这堵墙，再穿下一堵。
lines.en: Through this wall, then the next.

lines.zh: 剑尖在前面拖出一条细痕。
lines.en: My sword tip drags a thin line ahead.
I skim along the ceiling.

lines.zh: 从你背后绕一圈，再绕回来。
lines.en: A loop behind you, then back again.

lines.zh: 石头挡不住我，只有光能。
lines.en: Stone cannot stop me; only light can.

lines.zh: 一下左，一下右，让你看花眼。
lines.en: Left, right; let your eyes blur.

lines.zh: 我飘得很轻，落地没有声音。
lines.en: I float light; my landing makes no sound.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头还有一间房要查。
lines.en: One more room at the end of the hall to check.
In dark caves I am most at ease.

lines.zh: 我绕着那只火把转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle that torch twice.

lines.zh: 我的剑比我还急着往前。
lines.en: My sword is more eager than I am.
Floating along, legs are unnecessary.

lines.zh: 我从这扇窗穿到那扇窗
lines.en: I pass from one window to the next.

lines.zh: 剑在墙上划了一道白线
lines.en: My sword scores a white line on the wall.
I count my own giggles.
The master has not called; I wait.
There is an old notch in my blade.
The dust in this room does not move.
I toy with cobwebs on my sword tip.
Being alone is not so bad.
I remember the master before this one.
Count to a hundred, then start over.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙听外面的脚步。
lines.en: I press to the wall and listen for steps.
My laughter echoes in the empty hall.
This lamp is too bright.
Tired of drifting, I hang in midair.
You see me now; too late.
Your face is interesting.
I am counting the hairs on your head.
You are shivering; I can hear it.
The master says you must stay.
Your sword is heavy; mine is just right.
Do not turn; I am on your shoulder.
You blinked three times. I counted.
I laugh, and you tense up.
You smell of rust.
You actually hit me.
My wings are askew.
It hurts, and I am still laughing.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的翅膀，笑声断了。
lines.en: You struck my wing, and my laughter cut off.
I retreat toward the ceiling.
The iron sword nearly slipped.
The thread that called me is trembling.
You are a little stronger than the last one.
I scatter halfway, then gather again.
The master will keep this score for me.

lines.zh: 你手里那点亮光是什么？
lines.en: What is that glimmer in your hand?
The smell of enchantment; I like it.
Give it to me and I will stab you one time less.
The master never taught me not to take.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我都要摸一摸。
lines.en: Shiny things, I must touch them all.
Hold it higher; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 这个能附在我的剑上吗？
lines.en: Can this go on my sword?
I reach out; better not pull back.
Magic hums; I can hear it.
Just one touch, I promise.
Bumped into me? You are bold.

lines.zh: 我穿过去了，你撞的是空气。
lines.en: I passed through; you hit air.
Do not shove; even floating I take space.

lines.zh: 我的剑碰到了你的盔甲。
lines.en: My sword clinked on your armor.
You knocked my laughter apart.
Move; I need to pass this wall.
One bump and I remember you.
We are crammed in this narrow hall.
I do not fear collisions; I fear light.
You step back, I drift forward.
The master calls two at once; perfect.
Is your sword iron too?
When we laugh, our voices match.
Through the wall together; see who is first.
Your wings are a little faster.

lines.zh: 两只恼鬼，屋里就热闹了。
lines.en: Two vexes make a room lively.
Do not steal my prey.

lines.zh: 我们并排飘着，影子叠一起。
lines.en: Side by side, our shadows overlap.

lines.zh: 主人会给我们都附魔吗？
lines.en: Will the master enchant us both?
Vanishing together still counts as company.
I cannot pick it up; my sword fills my hand.
I do not care to touch what falls.
A scrap of iron; boring.
I lift it on my sword tip to look.
The master collects things; not my job.
Shiny; that is mine now.
Even if I picked it up, I have nowhere to put it.
This is dusty; filthy.

lines.zh: 让它躺着吧，反正没人要。
lines.en: Let it lie; no one wants it.
I only hold my sword; nothing else.

lines.zh: 主人指了方向，就是你了。
lines.en: The master pointed; you are the one.
I smell the life on you.
Target here; do not let it run.
My sword is warming up.
The one with the shield; deal with him first.

lines.zh: 房间里只有你一个活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing in this room.

lines.zh: 我笑了一声，你就该跑了。
lines.en: I giggle once; that is your cue to run.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡挡在前面？绕过去。
lines.en: An iron golem in front? Go around.
I have you locked; do not blink.

lines.zh: 那扇门关着，我从缝里进去。
lines.en: That door is shut; I slip through the crack.
I circle you; try not to get dizzy.
You step back; I close an inch.
My giggle is right at your ear.
My sword tip points at your throat.
Raise your shield; I switch sides.
Neither of us should blink.
Waiting for help? There is none.
I drift against your back.
Your breathing is getting faster.
I strike when I reach three.
One cut, quick, hardly painful.
I giggle as the blade goes in.
The iron sword slides through with a whisper.
This strike carries Sharpness.

lines.zh: 你捂着的地方，我还会再来。
lines.en: I will come back to where you clutch.

lines.zh: 我的剑不落地，也不留情。
lines.en: My sword never drops, and never spares.
Strike, then drift off; I do not linger.
You fall, and I am still laughing.
The master's order is carried out.
This cut is a gift for you.
The master waves, and here I am.

lines.zh: 从烟雾里钻出来，剑已在手。
lines.en: Out of the smoke, sword already in hand.
This stone room again; I know it well.
I was laughing when I was born.
Which enchantment this time?
The summoning hum has not faded.
I hover, waiting for you to look up.
The iron sword is heavy; just right.
One more living soul in the room.
The master said: begin.
Fire on my wings; I cannot fly straight.
I fall; the sword lands first.
Water drags me down; my wings are heavy.
The blast spins me in circles.
An arrow passes through my shoulder.
Magic backlash chokes my laughter.

lines.zh: 我被召唤太久，快撑不住。
lines.en: Summoned too long, I am fading.
In the lightning glare I nearly come apart.
In the void there are no walls to pass.
